name: dsh-library
description: Local document knowledge base for a workspace: hybrid semantic and keyword retrieval, diversity re-ranking, citation-aware injection and integrity checks over a local SQLite index, with no model downloads.
longDescription: 工作区本地文档知识库：语义与关键词混合检索、多样性重排、带引用注入与完整性校验，索引为本地 SQLite，不下载任何模型。
